name: Keshet
source:
The Worker enters a room with spacial resonance, tasked with investigating its nature. The Mathematician tries to explain the nature of themselves and others. The Diplomat gently comunicates with the resonance, referring to their meetings as dates.

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/35-1-0-3691]Anivisual[/url]]
translation:
工人进入一个具有空间共振的房间，其任务是调查其性质。数学家试图解释自己和他人的本质。外交官温和地与共鸣进行交流，将他们的会议称为日期。

[译自[url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/35-1-0-3691]Anivis[/url]]
